components.css: .ds-steps{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;} .ds-step{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted,#9fb0c3);border:1px solid var(--line,rgba(0,245,255,0.16));border-radius:999px;padding:4px 14px 4px 6px;background:transparent;} .ds-step b{display:inline-grid;place-items:center;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--surface-2,#15102a);color:var(--muted,#9fb0c3);font-family:ui-monospace,'SFMono-Regular',Menlo,Consolas,'Liberation Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;} .ds-active{color:var(--text,#e9f8ff);border-color:var(--cyan,#00f5ff);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(0,245,255,0.25);} .ds-active b{background:var(--cyan,#00f5ff);color:var(--on-accent,#07030f);} .ds-done{color:var(--text,#e9f8ff);cursor:pointer;} .ds-done b{background:var(--green,#39ff14);color:var(--on-accent,#07030f);} .ds-done:hover{border-color:var(--green,#39ff14);} .ds-done:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--cyan,#00f5ff);outline-offset:2px;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(0,245,255,0.28);} .ds-arrow{width:7px;height:7px;border-right:2px solid var(--muted,#9fb0c3);border-bottom:2px solid var(--muted,#9fb0c3);transform:rotate(-45deg);margin:0 4px;}

components.name: View Switch

components.css: .ds-switch{display:flex;gap:4px;padding:4px;border:1px solid var(--line,rgba(0,245,255,0.16));border-radius:999px;width:max-content;} .ds-switch input{position:absolute;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;} .ds-switch span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding:0 16px;border-radius:999px;font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Roboto,'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:14px;color:var(--muted,#9fb0c3);cursor:pointer;transition:color .2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1),background .2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);} .ds-switch input:checked+span{background:var(--surface-2,#15102a);color:var(--text,#e9f8ff);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--line-strong,rgba(0,245,255,0.42));} .ds-switch input.ds-chg:checked+span{color:var(--magenta,#ff2bd6);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,43,214,0.55);} .ds-switch input:focus-visible+span{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(0,245,255,0.28);}

narrative.northStar: The Lit Sign in a Dark Lab
narrative.overview:
Stegatrix is a neon world pinned by the user and then disciplined: a near-black violet ground, flat hairline-bordered panels, and a small set of saturated neon colors that each carry exactly one meaning. The wordmark is the neon sign over the door; everything else in the room is quiet until something real happens. Glow is a signal, not a finish. It appears on the wordmark, on hidden data when it is revealed, on keyboard focus, on the active wizard step, and on the user's own ASCII art output. Nowhere else.

Density is moderate and tool-like. A single 1120px column holds a two-area hero (image viewer beside a reveal panel) and a stepped wizard of flat panels. The interface proves its mechanism by showing it, so the canvas viewer and the monospace data surfaces are the most important things on screen, and chrome stays out of their way.

The world refuses the neon-template habit of glowing every surface: panels, buttons and fields sit flat at rest, and hierarchy comes from color role and hairline weight rather than light.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black violet ground with two very faint corner washes (cyan top right, magenta bottom left).
One job per color: cyan interface, magenta hidden data, green success, amber warnings, rose-red errors.
Glow only on the wordmark, revealed data, focus, the active step, and user ASCII art.
Geist Bold for display text only; system sans for prose and controls; system monospace for data.
Flat, hairline-bordered panels; no nested cards; 44px minimum targets.
Drawn CSS chevrons instead of glyph icons.

rules.name: The One Job Rule
rules.body: Each neon color means one thing. Cyan is interface, magenta is hidden data, green is success, amber is warning, rose is error. A color never borrows another's meaning, and a state never appears in a color it does not own.

rules.name: The Magenta Is Secret Rule
rules.body: As a foreground or border, magenta appears only on hidden data or the control that reveals it. Its single non-data appearance is the 6% ambient wash in the bottom-left corner of the page ground.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Geist Bold speaks only in the wordmark, the hero H1 and step headings. System sans carries prose and controls. Monospace means "this is data". Never set prose in mono or data in sans.

rules.name: The One Weight Rule
rules.body: Only Geist 700 is shipped. Do not request other Geist weights; a lighter display needs a new face file and a deliberate decision.

rules.name: The Glow Is a Signal Rule
rules.body: If something glows, it is the brand sign, hidden data, focus, the current step, or the user's art. Panels, buttons and fields never glow at rest or on hover.

dos: Do give every neon color one meaning: cyan interface, magenta hidden data, green success, amber warnings, rose errors.
Do keep panels flat on the Night Violet surface with a 1px cyan hairline and 12px corners.
Do reserve glow for the wordmark, revealed data, focus, the active step and user ASCII art.
Do set the wordmark, hero H1 and step headings in Geist Bold, prose and controls in system sans, and all data in monospace.
Do make every target at least 44px tall and pair every focus state with the 2px cyan outline and 3px ring.
Do draw directional marks as rotated bordered squares in CSS.
Do make every animation instant or absent under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't glow panels, buttons or fields at rest or on hover.
Don't use magenta for interface chrome, or green, amber or rose outside their states.
Don't nest a card inside a panel.
Don't use type glyphs or emoji as icons; inline SVG is reserved for real logos.
Don't set Geist on prose, labels or controls, or load additional Geist weights without a decision.
